title: Discord Settings
info: These settings connect the Discord bot to your server. The bot will use these IDs to publish raid events and automatically create channels in the defined category.

guild_id.label: Discord Server ID
guild_id.description: Numeric ID of the Discord server the bot is connected to.

category_id.label: Raid Calendar Category ID
category_id.description: ID of the Discord category where raid channels will be created.

lock_hours.label: Signup lock (hours before raid)
lock_hours.description: Window before the raid during which players can no longer change their signup. Admins are exempt. Set to 0 to disable.

reminder_hours.label: Auto reminder (hours before lock)
reminder_hours.description: The bot automatically pings players with no status, once per raid. Set to 0 to disable.

confirm_reminder_hours.label: Second reminder (hours before raid)
confirm_reminder_hours.description: The bot mentions starters and tentative signups and announces the composition by role, once per raid. Set to 0 to disable.

timezone.label: Time zone of Discord messages
timezone.description: Time zone the bot uses for dates and times in announcements and reminders. In the app, everyone sees times in their browser's time zone.

invite_bot_row.label: Discord bot
invite_bot_row.description: Add the bot to your Discord server before entering the IDs below.
